rfam.comment: This family represents the 44 nucleotide K10 transport/localisation element (TLS) from Drosophila melanogaster. K10 TLS is responsible for the transport and anterior localisation of K10 mRNA and acts to establish dorsoventral polarity in the oocyte [1]. K10 TLS structure was reported in the PDBs 2KE6, 2KUR, 2KUU, 2KUV, and 2KUW [3].
